notes.title: Development Update — What Lurks Ahead
notes.notes:
Greetings !! 



Development Update

Hey everyone! Hope you're all doing great. We’ve got some exciting news to share today — a new update is just around the corner, and it’s packed with some chilling improvements!

Sanity System Incoming
We’re introducing a brand-new Sanity System that dynamically affects your gameplay. The lower your sanity, the more intense and unpredictable the horror becomes. Watch your mind… or lose it.

Horror Event Overhaul
We've updated several horror events to make them feel more immersive, terrifying, and reactive to your actions. Expect more tension, more surprises, and more reasons to stay on edge.

Coming Very Soon


Thanks for your patience and support — the nightmare is just getting started.

notes.title: Minor Patch Notes [v0.7.1c] — Day One
notes.notes:
Greetings!!

Here's the patch notes for version 0.7.1. It contains minor fixes that improve the general gameplay.


 Note Tips are now clearer. Candles remain the same, but it's much clearer what players should do with them.
 We made minor collision changes that were obstructing the player.
 We have added minor hints throughout the Prologue to make the experience a little more progressive.
 We fixed a bug where it was possible to bug the inventory, which could cause the item to be unavailable on load.
 Various minor changes.


We acknowledge that some people get frustrated with the hollow puzzle (Prologue). We hope the Note Tip clarification will help. We will keep reading your comments and feedback and we'll see what changes need to be made.

If you have suggestions or wish to report a bug, please check the Steam Community Discussions!
